description: Rising flood water is entering homes and several people are stranded near the bridge. Two people may be injured.
Water has risen around houses near the bridge and residents are asking for rescue assistance. Possible injuries reported.
Families are trapped by rapidly rising water close to the main bridge and need evacuation support.
Heavy rain has caused flooding in a residential area. Several residents report being unable to leave safely.
Flood water is blocking roads and a family reports an injured person inside their home.
